sloka: ततः समासाद्य रणे दशाननं समन्त्रिवर्गं सबलप्रयायिनम् ।हृदि स्थितं तस्य मतं बलं च वै सुखेन मत्वा ऽहमितः पुनर्व्रजे ।। ५.४१.९।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ samāsādya raṇe daśānanaṁ samantrivargaṁ sabalaprayāyinam ।hṛdi sthitaṁ tasya mataṁ balaṁ ca vai sukhena matvā 'hamitaḥ punarvraje ।। 5.41.9।।।।

translations.english: 'I can return happily only after I gauge the tenheaded Ravana's army in war, his strength, his companions including the ministers and his mind.
